categories.name: code-generation
categories.description: Code generation configuration and customization blocks

customDescriptions.value: Configure asynchronous task execution for generated code — use when deploying code with interrupt-driven or event-triggered execution on real-time targets
Insert custom C/C++ code into the generated code — use for integrating legacy code, hardware drivers, or platform-specific routines with Simulink Coder output
Generate a standalone S-Function from a subsystem — use for creating reusable simulation components or protecting IP while sharing models
